revenue.description: Order-grain booked revenue: SUM(orders.total_amount) over orders not cancelled. Cancelled orders never delivered, so they are excluded by default. Refunded orders WERE fulfilled then reversed — include them in gross booked revenue; exclude them only when net-of-returns is explicitly requested.

aov.description: AVG(orders.total_amount) at order grain. NEVER AVG(order_items.line_total) — that is per-line, not per-order, and undercounts AOV by the average lines-per-order. Cancelled orders excluded by default; on this data excluding them barely moves AOV (cancelled orders are average-sized).

get_customer_by_id.description: Fetch a single Customer row by its primary key.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Surrogate key — unique identifier for every customer account

get_customer_by_id.returns: One customers row matching the given customer_id

get_orderitem_by_id.returns: One order_items row matching the given item_id

get_active_orders.description: Returns all non-terminal Order rows. Applies: status NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled')
get_active_orders.sql_template:
SELECT * FROM orders
WHERE status NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled')
get_active_orders.returns: All orders rows that are not in a terminal lifecycle state

get_order_by_id.description: Fetch a single Order row by its primary key.
get_order_by_id.returns: One orders row matching the given order_id

get_product_by_id.description: Fetch a single Product row by its primary key.
get_product_by_id.returns: One products row matching the given product_id

get_review_by_id.description: Fetch a single Review row by its primary key.
get_review_by_id.returns: One reviews row matching the given review_id

total_customer_lifetime_spend.description: Sum of lifetime spend across all customers.
total_customer_lifetime_spend.sql_template: SELECT SUM(lifetime_spend) AS total_lifetime_spend FROM customers

get_orders_for_customer.description: Returns all orders placed by a specific customer.

revenue_by_status.description: Total revenue grouped by order lifecycle status.
revenue_by_status.sql_template: SELECT status, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY status

total_line_revenue.description: Sum of all line item totals across all order items.
total_line_revenue.sql_template: SELECT SUM(line_total) AS total_line_revenue FROM order_items

get_items_for_order.description: Returns all line items belonging to a specific order.

total_stock_value.description: Total monetary value of all product inventory at current prices.
total_stock_value.sql_template: SELECT SUM(price * stock_quantity) AS total_stock_value FROM products

average_review_rating.description: Average rating across all customer reviews.
average_review_rating.sql_template: SELECT AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews

get_reviews_for_order.description: Returns all reviews associated with a specific order.

HasTimestamp.description: Entity records when events occurred — has at least one temporal column.

HasMonetaryValue.description: Entity carries financial figures — prices, amounts, revenues, or costs.

HasLifecycle.description: Entity progresses through named states — has a status or state column with defined transitions.
property_patterns: status / state column with enumerated lifecycle values
